title: erianthus ravennae subsp. parviflorus
intro: Erianthus ravennae subsp. parviflorus, commonly known as Little Bluestem, is a perennial grass species native to North America. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to reduce pain and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Little Bluestem include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve gastrointestinal issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
